summary: Post-merge regression check for Fisher Family Portal. Backend: re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_disbursements.py — 35/35 pytest cases pass in 6.72s (login for all 3 roles, RBAC on /api/fund and /api/disbursements, admin create/edit + audit log, PDF receipt, member-scoped list + acknowledge + statement PDF, filters, categories, timezone PATCH valid+invalid+unauth, Stripe status/onboard-graceful/tax, resend email, invalid inputs 422, unknown member 404). Frontend Playwright regression against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: (1) Admin login → dashboard → /disbursements loads ledger with fund cards and Total; admin creates a $12.34 disbursement via full dialog (member/amount/date/category/method), row count went 0→7 after create (initial 0 was a locator timing artifact — rows visible after create; ledger table renders correctly); receipt PDF downloads (application/pdf) via download-receipt-{id}; audit-dialog opens and contains 'create' entries. (2) Member (victoria) login → /my-statements shows 3 scoped rows; download-statement-button downloads statement PDF; /api/fund returns 403 as expected. (3) Account: member-timezone-select saves via PATCH /api/auth/timezone (verified via /api/auth/me → America/Los_Angeles); stripe-connect-button click returns 502 gracefully and page stays on /account (no crash). (4) Business (james) sees 7 disbursements via GET; POST /api/disbursements returns 403 as expected. No functional regressions from the git merge — all 7 review items pass.

issues: Pre-existing (not caused by merge): Emergent visual-editor injects <span> children inside <option> elements → React hydration warning in dev console. Cosmetic dev-only, not user-facing in production build. Flagged in iteration_4.

critical_code_review_comments: Carry-over from iteration_4 (still valid, not merge-related): server.py is >1700 lines and should be split into modules (auth, disbursements, stripe, pdf, email); money uses round(amount*100) → prefer Decimal; PDF generation is sync inside async handlers → offload; Stripe onboard 502 sometimes returns non-JSON body — wrap for JSON detail; add composite index on audit_log(disbursement_id, at).
No new issues introduced by the merge.
